pass_a_gloss: Trial as love-test per Deut 13; added unto God unto the increase of God.
pass_b_english: We must deem the standing trial to have become a proof and testing-place of our love toward the Divine. For 'the Lord shall tempt you,' as written in Deuteronomy, 'to know whether you love the Lord your God with your whole heart and your whole soul.' (Deuteronomy 13:3–4) But you, being tempted, 'shall go after the Lord your God, and fear him, and keep his commandments' (Colossians 2:19) — especially the 'Thou shalt have no other gods beside me' — 'and hear his voice, and be added to him': with him taking you from the places here, and adding you to himself, 'unto,' as the Apostle named it, 'the increase of God' in him.
